answer.thought: The body is a system of needs that has been violated by the state's failure to maintain the ethical substance of the household; the empty pot is not mere hunger but the negation of the universal in the particular. I sit in the white cotton, the heat leaving me, and I allow the spirit to withdraw into its own interiority, for there is no object in this room with which to dialectically engage. The silence is not empty; it is the negative space in which the concept prepares its return.
